title: Deluxe Ruby
description: This small mod adds the "DELUXE RUBY" to the game, it is crafted by surrounding a diamond with redstone
body:
This mod just adds a ruby to the game it can be crafted surrounding a diamond with redstone
you can use it in your mod, please use it in your mod if you want that'd make me very happy seeing you used Deluxe_ruby in a crafting of yours
if you want me to make any changes, requesting a version of the game to add the mod let me know in github i will gladly make it
